name: com.felkertech.channelsurfer.sync.DummyAccountIgnoreActivity
description: ChannelSurfer's account setup opens this Activity when its authenticator blocks adding another sync account. It displays a brief refusal and closes; it can also show the same kind of message for a removal request.
disableEffect: Android's account flow may not complete ChannelSurfer's add-account refusal screen, and account setup or channel sync can be disrupted.
